## A Mathematics Website

This website is my first ongoing project. I turn private study notes into clear pages and check the mathematics as I go. I plan to revise them as I learn more. The site uses Quarto and is intended for GitHub Pages.

## Multiclass SVM

[Multiclass SVM: The Crammer-Singer Approach](projects/multiclass-svm-crammer-singer.qmd) explains a direct method for multiclass classification. It develops the margin, the primal and dual problems, kernelisation, and the training method. It also compares the model with one-versus-rest and one-versus-one SVMs.
